title: Data & layout primitives
summary: Tables, lists, grids and blocks for showing real data cleanly, with tabular numbers everywhere.

components.name: Sortable data table
components.summary: Sticky header, sort chevrons with aria-sort, expandable detail rows and tabular numbers.
components.pattern: Table with sortable columns (APG Sortable Table)

components.name: Virtualised list
components.summary: Renders only the visible rows of 10,000 so scrolling stays smooth.

components.name: Bento grid
components.summary: Asymmetric feature tiles that collapse to one column on narrow containers.

components.name: Scroll-stacking cards
components.summary: Sticky cards that pile on top of each other as you scroll, earlier ones receding.

components.name: Comparison table
components.summary: Plan-by-feature matrix with a highlighted column and grouped rows.

components.name: Timeline / changelog
components.summary: Dated entries on a quiet rail, the newest marked with the accent.

components.name: Resizable split pane
components.summary: Two panes and a grip you can drag or move with the arrow keys.

components.name: Drag-to-reorder list
components.summary: Reorder rows by dragging a handle or with Space and the arrow keys.
components.pattern: List + live region (keyboard-accessible drag and drop)

components.name: Code block
components.summary: Monospace code with language tabs, a filename and a copy button.

components.name: Stat strip
components.summary: A row of KPIs with tabular values and semantic delta arrows.

components.name: Media card
components.summary: Image cards locked to an aspect ratio so a grid of them always lines up.

components.name: Avatar stack
components.summary: Overlapping initials with a +n counter for collaborators.

components.name: Description list
components.summary: Clean key–value rows for settings and record details.

components.name: Global filter bar
components.summary: One filter bar per dashboard: date range, removable chips, add and reset.
